correctness.rationale: Vertices are signed coordinate permutations of (1,1,t) with t=√2−1, defining six octagonal and eight triangular faces. For a>b>c>0 the facet-crossing count equals 4+2[ a<b+tc ]+2[ tb+c<a<(b+c)/t ]+2[ b>ta+c ]. Normalizing to (1,y,z), four line segments partition 0<z<y<1 into six precise positive-area chambers, proving exhaustive four-type support. The solid angle of the cone over each triangle is the 2 arctan determinant expression; symmetry gives factor 12/π. An independently written 24-vertex/14-face checker matched the indicator on 8000 directions and exact Ω formulas reproduce decimal probabilities summing to one; these checks corroborate the universal chamber argument.
